summary: Leading adjoint eigenvalues of the NACA 0012 steady flow at Re = 2000: the leading pair sigma = -0.0665 +- 8.006 i and the stable pair sigma = -0.557 +- 9.433 i, equal to the direct ones.
description: NACA 0012 adjoint global stability at Re=2000: leading eigenvalue and the stable pair sigma = -0.557 +- 9.433 i. The pair is read by row: row 9 of Spectre_NSa.dat (row 8 is its conjugate), because check_against_ref.py cannot select a row by value. The rows come from schur_tgt 8, maxmodes 10, k_dim 240; a run with other settings may order the rows differently.
